messages:
mira: Heads up — onboarding quantized-7b run just flooded the eval-harness queue, ~3.2k retries in 10m, lots of worker backpressure. attaching small log snippet

mira: ```
2024-06-14T15:02:31Z eval-runner[pid=3221] WARN shard=17 enqueue delay=512ms queue_len=121
2024-06-14T15:02:32Z eval-runner[pid=3221] ERROR shard=17 dispatch failed: kv-cache-miss timeout
2024-06-14T15:02:32Z eval-runner[pid=3221] RETRY task=eval:quant-7b attempt=3
2024-06-14T15:02:35Z worker[pid=4410] OOM while allocating 1.1GiB
``` 

ajay: ugh. do we know if it's sequence length distribution or batching blowup? :thinking:

linh: early guess: quantized model has uneven runtime per token after quant kernels kick in. a few long tails cause synchronized retries -> thundering. queue_len=121 is the red flag.

cecil: can reproduce locally with small harness. two things to try: 1) add jitter to retry/backoff, 2) implement soft_shard_capacity so dispatch respects headroom. trying patch now.

cecil: patch diff (concept):
```
- if queue_len >= shard_capacity: reject
+ soft_capacity = max(1, int(shard_capacity * 0.8))
+ if inflight >= soft_capacity: sleep(random.uniform(0, backoff))
``` 

mira: also seeing CI noise: eval-harness-ci flagged the quantized-7b perf test as a regression (latency p95 +40%). ops-bot linked below.

ops-bot: CI: eval-harness-ci failed — job/quant-7b-perf (build: 1182). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1182 :warning:

ajay: we should add a telemetry metric for `dispatch_stall_count` and wire it to the dashboard so we can correlate quant models -> queue stalls. right now alerts only watch overall queue length which blurs cause.

linh: good call. also add per-shard p50/p95/cpu and kv-cache-miss-rate. i can update the reporter to emit `evaller.shard.<shard_id>.kv_miss_rate`

cecil: tested the soft_capacity hack + jitter locally: numbers look better. before: retries=3200, avg_latency=420ms; after: retries=110, avg_latency=210ms. pushing a draft PR with unit test for randomized burst.

mira: awesome. once PR is up add a short CI job that replays the worst-case trace from /data/evaller/traces/quant-7b-spike.json so we don't regress.

ajay: agree — and add an eval alert: when `dispatch_stall_count > 50` for 2m -> page SRE. also create a dashboard panel that overlays `queue_len` + `kv_miss_rate` + `worker_ooms`.

mira: PR #2742 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/2742 — includes soft_capacity, jittered backoff, and a small replay CI step. tagging @cecil @linh for review :rocket:

linh: quick review done, left one nit about metrics naming. will merge after tests.

cecil: merged and deployed to staging. replayed trace, no surge, retries down to 98. rolling to prod during next maintenance window.

mira: marking this thread resolved for now. will follow up if prod shows anything unexpected. :white_check_mark:
